name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking with VIX Regime Filter
description: Daily carry-to-vol ranking for BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR. Carry = EM overnight/interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds (FRED). Vol = 63-day annualized realized FX volatility. Ranks 4 currencies by carry-to-vol ratio. VIX regime filter (FRED VIXCLS vs expanding median) splits 21-day and 63-day forward FX returns into low-vol and high-vol regimes to test whether the carry-to-vol premium survives risk-off environments.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING WITH VIX REGIME FILTER
# =============================================================================
# Carry = EM overnight/interbank rate (FRED) minus USD Fed Funds (DFF)
# Vol   = 63-day annualized realized FX volatility (price levels → volatility())
# Rank  = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=False) across 4 currencies daily
# VIX regime = VIXCLS vs expanding median (FRED economic_indicators)
# Forward returns = 21d and 63d FX returns, split by VIX regime
# =============================================================================

# --- FX Price Data (per-asset context via market_data_source) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- EM Overnight / Short-Term Rates (FRED, monthly → ffilled to daily) ---
# BRL: call money/interbank overnight (IRSTCI01BRM156N)
# MXN: call money/interbank overnight (IRSTCI01MXM156N)
# ZAR: 3-month interbank rate (IR3TIB01ZAM156N)
# IDR: call money/interbank overnight (IRSTCI01IDM156N)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01MXM156N')()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
idr_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01IDM156N')()

brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
idr_rate = ffill(idr_rate_raw.result)

# --- USD Fed Funds Rate (daily, DFF) ---
fed_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()
fed_rate = ffill(fed_raw.result)

# --- VIX (FRED VIXCLS, daily) ---
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

# --- Select the correct EM rate for this asset context ---
# is_asset_ref matches base ticker (e.g., 'BRLUSD' for BRLUSD-FX)
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='BRLUSD')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='MXNUSD')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='ZARUSD')()
is_idr = is_asset_ref(ticker='IDRUSD')()

em_rate = conditional_select(
    is_brl, brl_rate,
    is_mxn, mxn_rate,
    is_zar, zar_rate,
    is_idr, idr_rate,
    fed_rate
)

# --- Carry = EM rate minus Fed Funds (annualized %, same units) ---
carry = em_rate - fed_rate

# --- Realized FX Volatility (63-day annualized, decimal fraction) ---
# volatility() expects price levels — feeds close directly (S47)
fx_vol_63 = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# carry is in % (e.g., 8.5), vol is decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
# Normalize carry to decimal for consistent ratio: carry / 100 / vol
# Result: carry-to-vol in units of "% carry per unit of vol"
carry_decimal = carry / 100.0
carry_to_vol = where(
    is_valid(fx_vol_63) and fx_vol_63 > 0.001,
    carry_decimal / fx_vol_63
)

# --- Cross-Sectional Rank (1.0 = best carry-to-vol, 0.0 = worst) ---
# ascending=False: highest carry-to-vol gets rank 1.0
ctv_rank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# --- VIX Regime Classification ---
# Expanding median: regime is low when VIX <= its own historical median
vix_median = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Median)(vix)
is_low_vix  = is_valid(vix) and is_valid(vix_median) and vix <= vix_median
is_high_vix = is_valid(vix) and is_valid(vix_median) and vix > vix_median

# --- Forward FX Returns (price-based, S46: forward_returns on close is safe) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Split Forward Returns by VIX Regime ---
fwd_21d_low  = where(is_low_vix,  fwd_21d)
fwd_21d_high = where(is_high_vix, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_low  = where(is_low_vix,  fwd_63d)
fwd_63d_high = where(is_high_vix, fwd_63d)

# --- VIX Regime Flip Event Detection ---
# Detect transitions: low→high (risk-off onset) and high→low (risk-on recovery)
vix_regime_int = 1.0 if is_high_vix else 0.0
regime_flip = crossany(vix_regime_int, 0.5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. CONTEXT: Carry-to-Vol Rank Time Series (all 4 currencies) ---
# cs_lines: one line per asset, rank 1.0 = best carry-to-vol
cs_lines(
    title='Which EM Currency Has the Best Carry-to-Vol? (Daily Rank)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Rank (1.0 = Best)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='Median Rank', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Teal, Color.Red],
    order=1
)(x_values=index().value, y_values=ctv_rank)

# --- 2. SNAPSHOT: Current Carry, Vol, and Ratio per Currency ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Current EM Carry-to-Vol Scorecard',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=2
)(carry, fx_vol_63, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank)

# --- 3. PUNCHLINE: Forward Returns by VIX Regime (per asset, grouped bars) ---
# Grouped mode: 4 stacks (Low-VIX 21d, High-VIX 21d, Low-VIX 63d, High-VIX 63d)
# Same series names across stacks per R11
xy_bars(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Premium Survives Low-VIX but Fades in Risk-Off',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Mean Forward FX Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='21d Return', color=Color.Blue,  stack='Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d Return', color=Color.Sky,   stack='Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='21d Return', color=Color.Red,   stack='High VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='63d Return', color=Color.Rose,  stack='High VIX')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=(fwd_21d_low, fwd_63d_low, fwd_21d_high, fwd_63d_high))

# --- 4. EVENT MARKER: VIX Regime Flips ---
# Captures each low→high and high→low transition with carry-to-vol context
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='VIX Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='VIX Level',
                dp=1,
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio',
                dp=3,
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Carry (%)',
                dp=2,
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FX Vol (Ann.)',
                dp=3,
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(vix, carry_to_vol, carry, fx_vol_63, regime_flip)
